headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when Samoa Joe vs. Darby Allin fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.08 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Joe powerbombed Allin onto the exposed concrete floor before finishing him off with the Coquina Clutch to retain the TNT Championship.
Looking back to 2024, when Mark Briscoe vs. Daniel Garcia met in a Continental Classic League Match, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 7.66 ? a strong outing.

Back on this day in 2022, The Acclaimed vs. FTR went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.19 ? a real highlight of the night. The Acclaimed weathered a hungry FTR challenge, with Bowens' Mic Drop on Cash Wheeler sealing the win to retain the AEW World Tag Team Championship.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when it was Shawn Dean's first night in AEW in a Battle Royal match against Ricky Starks vs. Brian Cage vs. Dalton Castle vs. Ethan Page vs. Kip Sabian vs. Lee Moriarty vs. Dustin Rhodes vs. Jack Perry vs. Matt Hardy vs. Orange Cassidy vs. The Butcher, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.19.
Looking back to 2022, when Daniel Garcia made their return to AEW television after 6 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
Flash back to 2024, when Serena Deeb returned to the fold after 2 months away, appearing on Collision.
